_about: CF-010 — single source of truth for every agent's provider, prompt and budget (ADR-010). WF-3 reads it; changing `mode` switches the long-writing agents between Gemini (hybrid) and the local 4B model. Measured basis: eval/latency/budget.md.
_mode_note: hybrid = Router, tools, embeddings, checks local; Regulations / Admin draft / Composer on Gemini Flash-Lite (≈ 14 s per regulation question). local = everything on qwen3 4B (≈ 114 s per regulation question). ADR-010 accepted 26 Oct (decided on Fedi's delegation); amends ADR-003 and NFR-03.

cloud_data.guard: the local Router classifies first; personal-data requests are out_of_scope and never reach a cloud agent

latency.ack_message_fr: Je cherche dans le règlement et les tables… (quelques secondes)
latency.ack_message_fr_local: Je cherche dans le règlement… (jusqu'à 2 minutes en mode local)

local._num_thread_note: default (4 physical cores) — 8 threads gave no gain (eval/latency/tuning_2026-10-26.jsonl)

router._note: static system prompt + examples first → Ollama prefix cache (≈ 1 s prompt after the first call)

calendar._note: no LLM: Router entities → lookup → template reply

critic.on_fail: one revision, then safe fallback (« non trouvé » + contact)
critic._note: deterministic checks miss semantic inventions (T1-25): Phase 6 adds a grounding rule to Regulations v3
